title.romaji: [Hobonichi Techo] Monthly notebook planner "day-free" completion commemorative video
title.native: 【ほぼ日手帳】月間ノート手帳「day-free（デイフリー）」完成記念ムービー
synonyms: [Hobonichitechō] gekkan nōto techō `day - free (deifurī)' kansei kinen mūbī
[Hobonichi Techo] Monthly notebook planner "day-free" completion commemorative video

synopsis:
A new type of monthly notebook, "day-free," has been released for the Hobonichi Techo. It's a new type of notebook that combines a "monthly" and a "grid notebook." To commemorate its completion, we've created a promotional video.

(Source: Hobonikkan'itoishinbun YouTube Channel; translated)
